title: Keto Jamaican Chicken Pilaf
description: A funky and flavorful keto dish featuring chicken, cauliflower rice, and Jamaican spices, perfect for a post-workout meal. This recipe uses a sugar-free sweetener and is slow-cooked to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the Jamaican seasoning, chicken broth, and sugar-free sweetener to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cauliflower rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken and sauce.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the scotch bonnet peppers, if using.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
